mapper.select: SELECT ss.experiment_id, ss.experiment_name, COUNT(*) AS total_submissions, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ss.situation) IN ('C', 'AC', 'ACCEPTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ac_count, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ss.situation) IN ('E1', 'CE', 'COMPILE_ERROR', 'COMPILATION_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compile_error_count, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ss.situation) IN ('E3', 'WA', 'WRONG_ANSWER', 'MULTIPLE_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wrong_answer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ss.situation) IN ('E5', 'TLE', 'TIMEOUT', 'TIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeout_count, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ss.situation) IN ('P', 'PA', 'PARTIAL_ACCEPTED', 'PARTIAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.serial_number) AS question_count, AVG(CASE WHEN ss.runtime_ms IS NOT NULL AND ss.runtime_ms != '' AND ss.runtime_ms != '0' THEN CAST(ss.runtime_ms AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_runtime_ms, AVG(CASE WHEN ss.memory_kb IS NOT NULL AND ss.memory_kb != '' AND ss.memory_kb != '0' THEN CAST(ss.memory_kb AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_memory_kb, MAX(ss.score) AS max_score, AVG(ss.score) AS avg_score FROM submit_situation ss WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY ss.experiment_id, ss.experiment_name ORDER BY ss.experiment_id
SELECT ss.situation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM submit_situation ss WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.experiment_id = #{experimentId} GROUP BY ss.situation ORDER BY cnt DESC

choose.when: SELECT sp.student_no AS student_id, sp.real_name AS name, tc.name AS class_name FROM class_member cm JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.id = cm.student_id JOIN teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cm.class_id WHERE cm.class_id = #{classId} AND cm.member_status = 'ACTIVE' AND sp.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY sp.student_no
choose.otherwise:
SELECT student_id, name, class_name FROM student
AND (class_name = #{className} OR class_name LIKE CONCAT(#{className}, '%'))
ORDER BY student_id

mapper.select: SELECT student_id, name, class_name FROM student WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT ss.serial_number, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ss.situation) IN ('C', 'AC', 'ACCEPTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ac_count, MAX(ss.score) AS best_score FROM submit_situation ss WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.experiment_id = #{experimentId} GROUP BY ss.serial_number ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(ss.situation) IN ('C', 'AC', 'ACCEPTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile_ai_feedback (student_id, feedback, profile_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{feedback}, #{profileJson}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE feedback = #{feedback}, profile_json = #{profileJson}, updated_at = NOW()
